text:
carlos: hey finance — i took a taxi in london on 2026-02-28 and the corporate card charged me £42.70 but i lost the paper receipt. card portal shows txn id `UK-778211`. attached a photo of my bank card statement showing the charge. can i still file this expense?

emily_finance: thanks for flagging, @carlos. you can still submit but we need an approver attesting to the expense and a short note explaining lost receipt. please upload the bank statement snippet showing merchant name/date/amount, and fill the missing-receipt form (link: https://expenses.redwood.company/missing-receipt).

carlos: ok uploaded screenshot and filled the form. i assume VAT reclaim isn't possible without full invoice?

emily_finance: correct — VAT reclaim needs a full VAT invoice from the driver/company. finance can reimburse the gross amount but we won't reclaim VAT. you'll be reimbursed the charged amount in GBP converted to USD per the company conversion rate on submission day.

nina_manager: i approve this as the trip was work-related. i'll sign off in the expense app once @carlos submits. :white_check_mark:

travelbot: Ticket created: TR-2026-102 for missing taxi receipt. Please attach supporting docs. ETA initial review 3 business days.

emily_finance: when you submit, use these fields in the expense app:

```
Category: Ground Transport
Date: 2026-02-28
Amount: 42.70 GBP
Payment method: Corporate Card
Receipt status: Lost - Missing Receipt Form TR-2026-102 attached
Notes: lost paper receipt; bank statement shows txn id UK-778211; manager approval by nina_manager
```

carlos: submitted in expenses app and added manager approval. one more q: there was a £3 tip i left in cash. can i expense that without receipt?

emily_finance: small cash tips under £10 are reimbursable with manager approval and a short note of amount. include it as a separate line item `Cash tip - 3.00 GBP` and mark receipt status as `No receipt - manager attests`.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: follow up on TR-2026-102 in 7 days.

emily_finance: all set — i'll process reimbursement once the ticket is closed. i'll post back here when payment is issued. cheers! :money_with_wings:
